text: Eating well doesn't mean giving up all your favorite foods. Instead, aim for a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins, while allowing yourself occasional treats. Regular exercise, even just a 30-minute walk most days, strengthens your body and boosts your mood. Equally important is sleep—most adults need seven to nine hours each night to recharge fully. Don't overlook mental health, either. Stress can build up quickly, so practice simple techniques like deep breathing or journaling. Finally, protect your work-life balance. Set clear boundaries between work and personal time, and make space for hobbies and social connections. Small, consistent choices like these create a healthier, happier you.
